summary_en: Y57.04/share annual dividend (from Y54.76), including Y14.45/share per quarter (from Y13.69). Interim period H1 FY12/26 net income Y6,524M (+5.0% YoY) supported increase. Policy: payout ratio 65%+ minimum, DOE 10% floor. Next update if material changes arise.
title_en: Notice of H1 FY12/26 Interim Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Hike)
translation_en_brief: GMO Financial Holdings revised upward its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending December 2026 following release of interim (H1) consolidated results. The interim period (1 January–30 June 2026) delivered operating revenue of ¥29.5B (9.9% YoY growth), operating profit ¥10.4B (5.9% YoY), and net income attributable to parent shareholders ¥6.5B (5.0% YoY). The company recorded interim record earnings as CFD revenues remained elevated, FX and crypto revenues declined, and deposit investment gains and margin trading revenues grew. Based on interim net income and the company's stated payout policy (minimum 65% payout ratio, DOE floor of 10%), the quarterly dividend is raised from ¥13.69/share to ¥14.45/share, lifting the annual forecast from ¥54.76 to ¥57.04 per share. The ¥2.26 surplus per share is distributed equally across the remaining three quarters of FY12/26. The company will update guidance if material changes occur.
